page_title: RSO 0-3 GET | Real Sociedad v Getafe 26/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
90+6' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90+5' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Guillermo Cuadra and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+2' Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
90' Yellu Santiago (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Guillermo Cuadra had an easy-decision to make.
89' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

89' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) replaces Omar Alderete.
85' 0 - 3 Carles Perez (Getafe) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the middle of the goal.
84' Here is a change. Jon Ander Olasagasti is going off and Imanol Alguacil gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
83' Substitution. Yellu Santiago (Getafe) has come on for Luis Milla.
83' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.

79' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the left side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and David Soria makes a comfortable save.
79' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
76' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
74' 0 - 2 Spectacular goal! Carles Perez (Getafe) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
72' 0 - 1 Goal! Christantus Uche (Getafe) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home into the top of the net.
72' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Alex Remiro is alert and denies him with a nice save.
70' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Mikel Oyarzabal and he is replaced by Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad).
70' Here comes a substitution. Sergio Gomez is given a rest as he is replaced by Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad).
67' The Getafe players can’t believe it after referee Guillermo Cuadra signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
66' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Getafe as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
65' A clumsy foul by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle. A penalty is awarded to Getafe!
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.
63' Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul after Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
63' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Bertug Yildirim will be replaced by Borja Mayoral (Getafe).
62' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
61' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
56' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
55' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad). Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
54' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Omar Alderete (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
51' The substitution is prepared. Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aihen Munoz.
48' Djene (Getafe) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives a chance to Carles Perez and Alex Sola (Getafe) is off.
46' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Brais Mendez comes on the pitch for Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle. Alex Sola (Getafe) commits a foul after dangerous play.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
45+1' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

44' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! David Soria dived superbly to block a header by Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the roof of the net, but David Soria pulled off a remarkable save! Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
44' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
38' Real Sociedad seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
37' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
36' Djene (Getafe) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
34' Looks like Djene (Getafe) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
32' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
31' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Real Sociedad are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
29' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Guillermo Cuadra who sees an offensive foul.
27' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
25' It must be a yellow card. It is. Luis Milla (Getafe) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
20' The ball possession at the moment is 44:56.
18' Guillermo Cuadra blows the whistle, Luis Milla (Getafe) is penalised for a foul.
15' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
14' Guillermo Cuadra couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) and blew his whistle.
7' Christantus Uche (Getafe) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
7' Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Omar Alderete (Getafe).
5' Luis Milla (Getafe) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
3' Christantus Uche (Getafe) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Real Sociedad will kick the game off.
Guillermo Cuadra is the one to supervise the game today.
